references.text: God commands Moses to designate cities of refuge, which prepares the concept of cities of refuge further developed in Numbers 35:6.
Moses set apart three cities of refuge east of the Jordan, fulfilling the commandment regarding cities of refuge for someone who kills unintentionally.
Detailed instructions concerning the three cities of refuge in Canaan and their function to protect one who has killed someone by accident.
Joshua carries out the commandment about cities of refuge and describes their purpose to protect killers from the avenger of blood.
The Levites receive 48 cities in total, including the six cities of refuge, fulfilling the commandment in Numbers 35:6-7.
The list of Levitical cities confirms the distribution of cities to the Levites, including the cities of refuge.
The Epistle to the Hebrews uses the image of fleeing to a city of refuge as a parallel to the believer's hope in Christ.
